title: Monster Hunter 3G HD Ver.
install_folder: MH3G HD JP v96 - Static 50 - Bowgun Steadiness

preimages.meaning: 中文：强制效果 ID 0xAE 的 PPC 直接检查返回真。 / English: Force the direct PPC check for effect ID 0xAE to return true.
中文：强制效果 ID 0xAE 的 PPC 直接检查返回真。 / English: Force the direct PPC check for effect ID 0xAE to return true.

anchors.meaning: 中文：调用前把效果 ID 0xAE 放入 PPC 参数 r4。 / English: Loads effect ID 0xAE into PPC argument r4 before the call.
中文：调用前把效果 ID 0xAE 放入 PPC 参数 r4。 / English: Loads effect ID 0xAE into PPC argument r4 before the call.

known_risks: 中文：强制 JP v96 中弩偏移修正效果 ID 的全部直接检查；对照时只启用本项并关闭 #65，必须使用自带左右偏移的弩并在远距离对比弹道，零偏移弩无法验证。该项不改变 #49 的后坐力。 / English: Forces every direct JP-v96 check for the bowgun-deviation correction effect ID; for an isolated comparison, enable only this pack and disable #65, use a bowgun with built-in left/right deviation and compare trajectories at long range, because a zero-deviation bowgun cannot validate it. This does not change recoil from #49.
license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：把 3DS 静态 ARM 金手指 #50“弩无摇晃”转换为 JP v96 Wii U PPC 固定地址补丁；默认关闭，状态为 Runtime Experimental。 / English: Converts 3DS static ARM cheat #50 "Bowgun Steadiness" into fixed-address JP-v96 Wii U PPC patches; disabled by default and classified Runtime Experimental.
